reading.body:
Kansas has three identified data center facilities in this dataset, and none carries a reported megawatt figure, leaving the state's total power draw from these sites unknown.

The three facilities sit in two distinct locations. Two are clustered in the Kansas City suburbs of Lenexa and Olathe, near a major metropolitan area with established fiber and power infrastructure. The third, Cloud Storage Corp in Hays, is positioned well into the western part of the state, roughly 270 miles from that cluster.

Because total_mw is zero for all three, no conclusions about power consumption, grid load, or compute capacity can be drawn from this data. The record establishes presence and geography, not scale. Whether these facilities represent meaningful AI workloads or primarily serve general enterprise storage and processing functions is not answered here.
